first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also help reverse the 6% activation decline, with support from two inherited findings. Verify memory_86 because its reported adoption gains are not yet tied to sustainable qualified revenue. Also verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest situational alternative, but its long-term retention, account quality, and revenue durability are unclear and therefore consequential to the primary objective.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source directly matches the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. This is more consistent with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose verified cohort suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Residual uncertainty remains because the onboarding evidence confirms only 30-day retention, not long-term qualified revenue or renewal performance.
